rugby.snapshot: Rugby is a busy Warwickshire fibre town where build crews and one-van installers work side by side. Fleet contractors and structured-cabling firms running engineers across the town buy through our trade accounts, while sole traders and ex-BT broadband and CCTV installers order branded polo, hi-vis and softshell direct online with no account. We run both routes together so the crew and the single installer are kitted the same way.
rugby.s1_head: Kitting the field engineers of Warwickshire
s1loc: Rugby sits in the middle of a real full-fibre push. CityFibre has invested around 17 million pound rolling its gigabit network out across the town, starting around Cawston, while Openreach has a large FTTP build of its own and Virgin Media keeps upgrading on top, so much of the district now has gigabit coverage. The major fibre and mobile networks all field delivery partners and civils crews through areas like Brownsover, Newbold and Hillmorton, and a long tail of broadband, CCTV and structured-cabling installers takes on the work the big contractors leave behind.

Alongside the residential rollout Rugby has a strong commercial scene built on logistics. The big industrial estates north of the town, from Swift Valley and Brownsover to Europark on Watling Street, plus the rail freight terminal out toward the Northamptonshire border, all need structured cabling, fibre links and CCTV across warehouses and offices. Cabling firms and CCTV installers wire these distribution sheds, the town-centre offices and the schools in Cat5e, Cat6 and fibre, which keeps a steady base of commercial engineers working across Rugby and the wider county.
